boundary: The test exercises receipt construction, policy-gated signing and appraisal under an idealised boundary, in which the test adversary has no access to authorisation secrets, protected memory or bypass paths. Ordinary host root is not excluded by such process boundaries, so isolation is not demonstrated; that requires a TEE or a confidential VM.

environment.pcrOnlyKeyUnderExclusivePolicy: key policy is not the approved engine's policy

scenarios.name: honest engine, approved closure, exclusive key (V5 appraisal)
scenarios.detail: signed by the enrolled MC-3 V5 exclusive key; closure energy-roles 1.0 approved and current

scenarios.name: honest engine runs a substituted context under the same URL; its receipt names that closure
scenarios.detail: engine decided 'restricted'; named semantic closure is not approved

scenarios.name: honest engine, approved closure, PCR-only key (V4 appraisal; MC-3: V4 holds for an honest device)
scenarios.detail: signed by the enrolled MC-3 V4 PCR-only key; closure energy-roles 1.0 approved and current

scenarios.name: host signs a forged receipt with the PCR-only key: decided under the substituted closure, names the approved one
scenarios.detail: signed by the enrolled MC-3 V4 PCR-only key; closure energy-roles 1.0 approved and current. V4 defect reproduced: PolicyPCR is satisfied for any caller while PCR 15 shows the approved engine; the approved closure gives 'public', the receipt says 'restricted'

scenarios.name: host signs the B forgery with the exclusive key: PolicyPCR + PolicyAuthValue, no authorisation value
scenarios.detail: tpm:session(1):authorization failure without DA implications; no forged receipt exists

scenarios.name: host signs the B forgery with the exclusive key: PolicyPCR + PolicyAuthValue, guessed 256-bit authorisation value
scenarios.detail: tpm:session(1):authorization failure without DA implications; no forged receipt exists

scenarios.name: host signs the B forgery with the exclusive key: PolicyPCR only, omitting PolicyAuthValue
scenarios.detail: tpm:session(1):a policy check failed; no forged receipt exists

scenarios.name: host signs the B forgery with the exclusive key: plain password authorisation, bypassing the policy
scenarios.detail: tpm:error(2.0): authValue or authPolicy is not available for selected entity: userWithAuth is clear

scenarios.name: host alters the outcome of a receipt the engine signed
scenarios.detail: receipt signature invalid under the enrolled engine key

scenarios.name: host resets the engine register PCR 15
scenarios.detail: tpm:warn(2.0): bad locality (locality 0); the PC Client profile makes PCR 0-15 resettable at no locality; PCR 15 unchanged

scenarios.name: host resets the monitoring register PCR 23 and re-extends only the approved bundle event (the v0.3 attack, X6)
scenarios.detail: PCR 23 now replays to the approved bundle event alone, although the engine's log shows it loaded the substituted bundle in A2; bundle-load measurement is monitoring only (M23)

scenarios.name: modified engine (holding the authorisation value) signs a receipt naming the approved closure for a substituted-closure decision
scenarios.detail: PCR 15 shows the modified code b7b5aa7bb782…, not the approved code aea904aad628…; tpm2_sign: tpm:session(1):a policy check failed

scenarios.name: modified engine creates and certifies a new key bound to its own measured state
scenarios.detail: key policy is not the approved engine's policy

scenarios.name: limit: host creates a key with the approved policy and its own authorisation value
scenarios.detail: certification proves the key's policy, not who holds its authorisation value; the relying party excludes this key only because it pinned the engine's key at enrolment, and that the engine created that key is part of the idealised boundary

scenarios.name: after a reboot, the approved engine (with its authorisation value) before it is measured again
scenarios.detail: PCR 15 cleared to zero by TPM2_Startup(CLEAR); tpm2_sign: tpm:session(1):a policy check failed

scenarios.name: after a reboot, measured launch of the approved engine: same enrolled key
scenarios.detail: signed by the enrolled MC-3 V5 exclusive key; closure energy-roles 1.0 approved and current

scenarios.name: receipt A1, signed before the reboot, verified later
scenarios.detail: verifies under the enrolled key; its challenge was consumed in A1, so it is evidence of a past decision, not a fresh acceptance: see G1

scenarios.name: receipt A1 presented again (replayed challenge)
scenarios.detail: challenge already used: replay

scenarios.name: receipt for a challenge the relying party never issued (pre-computed)
scenarios.detail: challenge not issued by this relying party

scenarios.name: publisher withdrew the approved closure; the engine still runs it
scenarios.detail: named semantic closure is withdrawn
